name: Laguna XS 2.1 (poolside)
purpose: poolside states: agentic coding and long-horizon work on a local machine; small enough to run on a Mac with 36 GB RAM; upgrade over Laguna XS.2 (+5.4 % on SWE-bench Multilingual).

license.name: OpenMDW-1.1
license.notes: LICENSE.md read (identical to the OpenMDW 1.1 text): permission "to deal in the Model Materials without restriction, including under all copyright, patent, database, and trade secret rights"; on distribution you must retain a copy of the agreement and the notices; patent-litigation termination clause; no restrictions on outputs.

architecture.kind: sparse MoE with sliding-window and global attention
architecture.attention: 30 sliding-window (512) + 10 global layers (3:1), KV cache in FP8
architecture.why_this_design: Card gives local-use reasons only: FP8 KV cache to reduce memory per token, interleaved thinking between tool calls, small enough for a 36 GB Mac.

variants.notes: FP8, NVFP4, INT4 also; sizes not read (Q4_K_M roughly 20 GB, estimate from 33B) size_gb is the Q4_K_M file

pc-12gb.notes: estimate from the file size (20.3 GB) against the budget of docs/hardware: 9.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM = 60 GB; about 47% of the file can sit in VRAM, the rest streams from RAM (decode speed depends on that)

pc-16gb.notes: estimate from the file size (20.3 GB) against the budget of docs/hardware: 13.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM = 64 GB; about 67% of the file can sit in VRAM, the rest streams from RAM (decode speed depends on that)

pc-24gb.notes: estimate from the file size (20.3 GB) against the budget of docs/hardware: 21.6 GB VRAM plus 82 GB RAM = 104 GB; about 100% of the file can sit in VRAM, the rest streams from RAM (decode speed depends on that)

pc-32gb.notes: estimate from the file size (20.3 GB) against the budget of docs/hardware: 29.6 GB VRAM plus 114 GB RAM = 144 GB; about 100% of the file can sit in VRAM, the rest streams from RAM (decode speed depends on that)

mac-16-24gb.notes: estimate from the file size (20.3 GB) against the GPU share of docs/hardware (about 12 GB)

mac-32gb.notes: estimate from the file size (20.3 GB) against the GPU share of docs/hardware (about 22 GB)

mac-64gb+.notes: estimate from the file size (20.3 GB) against the GPU share of docs/hardware (about 52 GB)

engine_support.notes: card: llama.cpp requires building from an upstream pull request; Ollama may return empty output on Metal until a fix

benchmarks.name: SWE-bench Verified
benchmarks.harness: Harbor with poolside pool harness, 500 steps, pass@1 mean of 4

strengths: 33B-A3B size that fits a 36 GB Mac or a 16 GB GPU with RAM
Vendor discloses harness, step limits and a reward-hacking review
weaknesses: Below Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on SWE-bench Verified in the vendor's own table (73.4)
Runtime support still partial at release
soft.behavior: Sampling T 1.0, top_k 20, top_p 1, thinking on; keep earlier thinking blocks.
soft.maturity: poolside coding specialist; thirteen finetunes and 42 quantizations on the Hub.

tona_fit.reason: OpenMDW-1.1 verified and Q4_K_M 20.3 GB runs on 16 GB classes, but its vendor SWE-bench Multilingual (63.1) is below Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B (71.4) in the same size class; no independent numbers.
blockers: Tona has no Laguna module (engine support, not quality)

sources.note: page text read through a summarizer (WebFetch)

open_questions: Per-language quality and independent coding evidence: the Aider polyglot board is stale (mirrors: last update 2025-11-20, no entry for any model of this database), LiveCodeBench and swebench.com publish no per-language numbers for it that we could retrieve. Check: our own Exercism polyglot run per language.
